claims.quote: The Laos blackline torpedo loach, Nemacheilus longistriatus, is a nemacheilid loach from the Mekong in Thailand and Laos.
The Laos blackline torpedo loach, Nemacheilus longistriatus, is a nemacheilid loach from the Mekong in Thailand and Laos.
Described from the mainstream of the Mekong River in Loei and Chiang Mai provinces, Thailand but since recorded further south from the Khorat Plateau and below the Khone Phapheng waterfalls in Laos.
